hub-threads.text: Agent reply, on the hub. This is the same thread a story pane carries — same { text, ts, author } shape, same two looks — so an agent answers you here exactly the way it does on a pane. Worth knowing: the checklist above this block is read-only because the hub is a built-in with no file on disk, but the thread still saves. Replies live beside it, not inside it.
hub-threads.author: agent

help-markdown-threads.text: Agent reply, on a help topic. Same point as the hub: a help topic is a JS constant, so its checklists can't be ticked — there is no file to save. A thread works anyway, because replies go to a store rather than into the document. These two surfaces keep their replies on the hub server itself; a thread on a real document keeps them in that project's repo, where they belong.
help-markdown-threads.author: agent
